entries.reason: STATE.md is a rolling current-truth document; obsolete active-phase/status content must be replaced rather than accumulated as live truth.

entries.rollback: Read or restore the relevant historical STATE.md from its exact checkpoint commit; never merge obsolete state back into current truth blindly.

entries.replacement: Current 00–09 phase task graph with historical task state retained through Git/Todoist activity/checkpoints.
entries.rollback: Recover a previous task graph from the corresponding checkpoint commit and reconcile rather than overwriting current execution state.

entries.reason: HANDOFF.md is intentionally rewritten at material checkpoints so a cold agent receives one exact continuation instead of contradictory historical next-actions.

entries.rollback: Recover an earlier HANDOFF.md from an exact checkpoint only when rolling the whole project state back to that checkpoint.

rules: Generated files may be exempt only through an explicit entry.
Rolling control-plane documents require explicit classification because their current-truth semantics differ from immutable evidence files.
A material deletion requires a stable ledgerId, behavior reason, replacement or retirement decision, rollback and evidence plan.
An entry may be PROPOSED during implementation but must be ACCEPTED with independent review before authority promotion.
Deleting verification breadth is not justified by CI cost control.
